description: Scottish landscapes and later geological investigations trace water, deep time, mountain building, glaciation and the dependence of life on energy from the Sun.

s04e01.description: Iain Stewart investigates scotland's water, using landscapes, geology and field evidence to show how Earth’s physical processes shaped environments and human history.

s04e02.description: Iain Stewart investigates deep time, using landscapes, geology and field evidence to show how Earth’s physical processes shaped environments and human history.

s04e03.description: Iain Stewart investigates moving mountains, using landscapes, geology and field evidence to show how Earth’s physical processes shaped environments and human history.

s04e04.description: Iain Stewart investigates the big freeze, using landscapes, geology and field evidence to show how Earth’s physical processes shaped environments and human history.

s04e05.description: Iain Stewart investigates life from light, using landscapes, geology and field evidence to show how Earth’s physical processes shaped environments and human history.
